verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents a one-shot `opencode run "..."` command and a `--auto` flag that approves permission requests not explicitly denied, so it can run unattended. It also offers a headless `opencode serve` HTTP server with an OpenAPI endpoint, a JS/TS SDK for programmatic control, and execution inside GitHub Actions runners, and a community user confirms `serve` works in practice. Missing for 10: documented output formats and exit-code behaviour for scripted `run` use, and independent hands-on corroboration of `opencode run` in automation scripts.
